title: Replication package for: From Requirements to Testable Boundaries: Measuring Change Containment Under Technology Substitution in Enterprise AI Platforms
description: Evidence and reproduction steps for the paper's derivation and evaluation claims. Version 1 content is preserved: requirements traceability, alternative decompositions, the 40-cell commercial-platform evidence matrix, the 36-cell documentary triangulation, the falsification assessment, and the Model Services technology-substitution experiment (F3) with its negative control. Version 2 adds two dated corrections to the F3 results record and the complete record of the second substitution test (T3, AI Runtime response cache, in-process to Redis): protocol, frozen records for each freeze, harness and test-only recorder, fixed inputs, repairs and regression tests, and the evidence of all three runs, including the two unsuccessful runs that exposed the packaging and cache-key defects. It also adds the complete record of the third test (T4, Knowledge Services, pgvector and Qdrant built against the pre-existing retrieval contract, then substituted by configuration): protocol, frozen corpus, queries and inventory, both adapters' introduction records, the frozen harness and test-only recorder, the run evidence, the report and the review decision. T4's containment held while two behavioural assertions failed; both outcomes are reported as recorded. The screening decision not to run two further drafted tests is included.
